hints.text: Point at the glowing ring and hold the TRIGGER to fire your tether. Let go of the trigger to release.
hints.desktop: Aim at the glowing ring and hold the LEFT MOUSE BUTTON to fire your tether. Release to let go.

hints.text: Push the LEFT STICK the way you want to swing. Let go near the top of the arc to fly.
hints.desktop: W A S D pumps the swing. Release near the top of the arc to fly.

hints.text: Swing into the bell. Its toll opens the way down. Only down.
hints.desktop: Swing into the bell. Its toll opens the way down. Only down.

hints.text: Studded stone can be climbed. Reach a hand to it, hold GRIP and pull: your hand stays, you move. Let go to launch.
hints.desktop: Studded stone can be climbed: stand close, hold F, then W A S D to climb. SPACE hops off.

hints.text: Hanging? Pull the RIGHT STICK back to let out rope and lower yourself. Push it forward to reel in.
hints.desktop: Hanging? SHIFT lets out rope to lower yourself. SPACE reels you in.

sections.name: The Long Swing
sections.subtitle: Every fall here is kept. So is the count.

hints.text: Two hands, two tethers. Run, fire at the hook under the floor above, and let go on the upswing.
hints.desktop: LEFT and RIGHT MOUSE fire two tethers. Run, fire at the hook, and release on the upswing.

hints.text: Falling? Fire again — any anchor will catch you. The rope forgives; the floor keeps.
hints.desktop: Falling? Fire again — any anchor will catch you. The rope forgives; the floor keeps.

hints.text: Hook the counterweight. Squeeze GRIP to haul it. It is heavier than stone should be.
hints.desktop: Hook the counterweight. Hold F to haul it. It is heavier than stone should be.

hints.text: Squeeze the GRIP on a tethered hand for a hard yank toward its anchor.
hints.desktop: F yanks your tethers: a hard pull toward the anchors.

sections.name: Broken Gallery
sections.subtitle: Closed from this side. Measured from the other.

hints.text: Missed a landing? Don't wait — fire at a lower ring.
hints.desktop: Missed a landing? Don't wait — fire at a lower ring.

hints.text: Dust falls before the stones. Wait for the gap. Do not look at what falls.
hints.desktop: Dust falls before the stones. Wait for the gap. Do not look at what falls.

hints.text: Hook the ring on the turning gear and hold on. Something inside is turning it.
hints.desktop: Hook the ring on the turning gear and hold on. Something inside is turning it.

hints.text: Ticking on the walls: it measures the whole. Chain a second rope, break its sight, or hook it.
hints.desktop: Ticking on the walls: it measures the whole. Chain a second rope, break its sight, or hook it.

sections.name: The Listening Vault
sections.subtitle: Something answered the knock. It knew the rhythm.

hints.text: Hold your lantern to the cold lamps. Light them before the walls notice.
hints.desktop: Walk up to each cold lamp and look at it. Light them before the walls notice.

sections.name: The Gullet Stair
sections.subtitle: It has your scent. It had theirs.

hints.text: Something made of the lost is coming down after you. Keep moving.
hints.desktop: Something made of the lost is coming down after you. Keep moving.

hints.text: Below: two ways down, marked by plaques. THE LONG STAIR: slow and certain. THE THROAT: quick and thin — its frayed rings snap under load.
hints.desktop: Below: two ways down, marked by plaques. THE LONG STAIR: slow and certain. THE THROAT: quick and thin — its frayed rings snap under load.

hints.text: Hide behind the keystone and let it knock. Or haul its ring.
hints.desktop: Hide behind the keystone and let it knock. Or haul its ring.

sections.name: The Two Descents
sections.subtitle: Slow and certain, or quick and carried. Never up.

hints.text: The deep rings are rusted. Get closer. Nobody has come back up to oil them.
hints.desktop: The deep rings are rusted. Get closer. Nobody has come back up to oil them.

sections.name: The Hollow Nave
sections.subtitle: Nothing to stand on. Nothing to bury.

hints.text: Chain the rings: fire your other hand at the next ring before you let go of this one.
hints.desktop: Chain the rings: fire the other mouse button at the next ring before you let go of this one.

hints.text: Hang on in the nave. The floor unbolts while you hold. Do not watch where it goes.
hints.desktop: Hang on in the nave. The floor unbolts while you hold. Do not watch where it goes.

sections.name: The Last Throat
sections.subtitle: Down. Now. Everything here wants you down.

hints.text: The grate — run for the light. Do not look at the walls.
hints.desktop: The grate — run for the light. Do not look at the walls.

decor.text: HERE THE DESCENT BEGINS. TRUST THE RING, NOT THE FLOOR. THE FLOOR KEEPS.
THE LAMP DOES NOT RISE TO MEET US. WE GO DOWN TO IT. IT DOES NOT SEND US BACK.
A YEAR TO LOWER THE FIRST LAMP. THE ROPE CAME BACK WET.
NINTH GALLERY — CLOSED FROM THIS SIDE. THE STONE HAS BEEN LISTENING.
THE GALLERY FELL TWICE. IT WAS REBUILT WITH THOSE IT FELL ON.
DO NOT ANSWER WHAT KNOCKS FROM INSIDE THE WALL. IT HAS LEARNED OUR KNOCKS.
THE VAULT WAS NOT DUG. IT WAS FOUND FULL, AND LISTENING.
THE MASONS WENT DOWN TO MEND THE DEEP COURSE. THE WALL MENDED ITSELF. THEY WERE NOT RETURNED.
A MASON CUT EACH LEDGE. THE LEDGE BELOW WAS CUT FROM HIM.
THE LONG STAIR — FOR THE PATIENT, WHILE THE LAMPS HOLD.
THE THROAT — FOR THE LATE. IT IS NEVER EMPTY.
THE PATIENT REACH THE BOTTOM. THE LATE ARE CARRIED THERE, INSIDE.
IT WEARS OUR WORK. NONE OF OUR STONE WAS QUARRIED.
BELOW THIS MARK NO LAMPS. ONLY THE STILL ONE, AND WHAT IT HOLDS.
THE LAST LANTERNWRIGHTS RESTED HERE. THE WALLS STILL HAVE THEIR SHAPE.
THE MASONS' REST. IT CANNOT FOLLOW. IT WAITS.
LET IT KNOCK. DO NOT KNOCK BACK.
THE NAVE OPENS FOR THOSE WHO HANG. MANY STILL DO.

blood.text:
NINE OF US CAME DOWN
TO MEND THE DEEP COURSE.
HOB. DAY ONE.

HALLAM KNOCKED TWICE
FOR LUCK.
THE WALL KNOCKED THREE.

FORTY STROKES BY THE
LAMP. NONE OF US CUT
THEM. HOB SAYS LEAVE IT.

WE TRIED TO GO BACK UP.
THE ROPE WAS TIED OFF
FROM ABOVE.

FIRST NIGHT. SOMETHING
WALKED THE SILL. IT HAD
OUR FOREMAN'S STEP.

THE STATUES WERE NOT
CARVED. THEY WERE
STOOD UP.

MAB FELL HERE NINETY
TIMES. SHE WOKE NINETY.
THE FLOOR KEPT THEM ALL.

MAB COUNTED THE STATUES.
THIRTEEN. COUNTED AGAIN.
FOURTEEN.

WE HAULED THE WEIGHT
FOR AN HOUR. SOMETHING
HAULED BACK.

ONE STATUE HAS HOB'S
FACE. HOB IS ALIVE.
I WENT AND CHECKED.

I CLOSED IT MYSELF.
SIX WERE STILL INSIDE.
WENNA

DAY NINE. HOB SAYS WE
ARE STILL NINE. I COUNT
TEN SHADOWS AT THE LAMP.

THEY KNOCK IN THE ORDER
I BRICKED THEM IN.
SIX. ALWAYS SIX.

IT TICKS WHEN I AM
WELL. IT STOPS WHEN I
BLEED. SO I BLEED.

IT DREW ME ON THE WALL.
CHALK. MY OWN SHAPE.
IT SAID NOT YET.

I ANSWERED. IT KNOCKED
BACK IN MY BROTHER'S
RHYTHM. TAMSIN

THE LAMPS WERE NEVER FOR
SEEING. THEY KEEP THE
DEAD IN THE WALLS STILL.

TAMSIN WENT BACK TO
ANSWER IT AGAIN.
WE DID NOT STOP HER.

I RELIT THE LAMP. THE
WALL BEHIND IT WENT
QUIET. A HELD BREATH.

I WROTE DOWN THE KNOCKS.
THEY SPELL A NAME.
NOT ONE OF OURS.

IT IS MADE OF US.
I SAW HALLAM'S HANDS
IN ITS SIDE. HOB

WE ARE FOUR. WE STOPPED
BURYING. THE WALL TAKES
THEM BEFORE WE CAN.

I LET IT KNOCK.
SIX HOURS. IT ONLY
WANTS TO BE NAMED.

IT CAME WHEN COLL CUT
HIS HAND. NOT BEFORE.
IT CAN SMELL IT.

WE TRIED TO KILL IT.
YOU CANNOT KILL A WALL.
WE APOLOGISED TO IT.

COLL TOOK THE THROAT.
HE WAS CARRIED.
WE STILL HEAR HIM.

I HAVE SAT UNDER THIS
LAMP FOUR DAYS. I AM
NOT GOING ON. HOB

THE BOTTOM IS NOT A
PLACE. IT IS A MOUTH,
AND WE ARE THE TEETH.

THERE IS NO WAY UP.
WE LOOKED FOR SIX DAYS.
EVERY STAIR GOES DOWN.

THE WHITE ONE WAITS
FOR YOU TO HEAL. THE
OTHER FOR YOU TO BLEED.

OUR WORK WAS OUR DEAD.
WE CUT THEM SQUARE AND
BUILT. I CUT MY SISTER.

I CARVED THE SPIRE TO
POINT HOME. IT POINTS
DOWN. ISOLDE

I FOUND MY MOTHER IN
THE THIRD COLUMN. I
KNEW HER BY HER RING.

WE ARE TWO. HOB AND I.
HOB IS NOT HOB.
I DO NOT SAY SO.

WE WERE NOT SENT TO
MEND. WE WERE SENT TO
BE TRIED ON.

THERE IS NO DEEP COURSE
TO MEND. WE WERE SENT
DOWN TO FEED IT.

THE STILL ONE DOES NOT
SAVE YOU. IT KEEPS YOU.
LOOK AT THE WALLS.

WE WERE NINE.
YOU MADE TEN.
YOU ALWAYS MAKE TEN.

IT DROVE US DOWN LIKE
SHEEP. IT NEVER ONCE
TRIED TO STOP US.

WE ALL STOOD IN IT.
NONE OF US FIT.
IT IS CUT FOR YOU.

THE GRATE CLOSED
BEHIND US TOO.
IT ALWAYS CLOSES.

boards.text: IF YOU WAKE HERE AND DO NOT REMEMBER THE CLIMB DOWN, THERE WAS NONE.
THE CAP WAS SET IN LIME SO THAT NONE WOULD FOLLOW. NONE HAVE COME THROUGH IT.
COUNT YOURSELF AT THE LAMP. COUNT AGAIN AT THE BOTTOM.
DO NOT CALL UP THE SHAFT. IT IS FARTHER THAN IT WAS.

LAMPS LIT: 4,112.
LAMPS PAID FOR: 4,111.
WE TRIED SALT, THEN SONG, THEN SILENCE. SILENCE WAS WORSE.
THE STATUES FACE THE LAMP. IF ONE DOES NOT, TELL NO ONE WHICH.
ROPES LOWERED: 38. ROPES RETURNED: 38. RETURNED EMPTY: 37.
THIS FLOOR IS BRAM AND HIS BROTHERS. WALK SOFTLY.
IT TOOK TWO YEARS FOR THIS ONE COURSE TO FINISH SETTLING. DO NOT LEAN ON IT.
THE NINTH WAS SEALED THREE TIMES: WITH LIME, WITH IRON, WITH THE NINE.
THE CAGE CAME UP FORTY-ONE TIMES. IT WENT DOWN FORTY-TWO.
MEASURED HERE: FOURTEEN HANDS AND A KNOCK. NOT YET.
THE GALLERY WAS CLOSED FOR NINE YEARS. WHEN IT WAS OPENED THE COUNT WAS HIGHER.
THE GEAR WAS TURNED BY HAND FOR SIX YEARS. THEN IT WAS TURNED FROM INSIDE.
FORGIVE THE SMALL STONES IN THIS COURSE.
THIS LAMP WENT OUT ONCE. WE DO NOT SPEAK OF THE WEEK THAT FOLLOWED.
WHO LIT THIS LAMP? WHO IS STILL HOLDING IT?
KNOCK ONCE: WE ARE HERE. KNOCK TWICE: WE ARE COMING. NEVER KNOCK THREE.
THE VAULT HOLDS NINE THOUSAND. IT WAS BUILT FOR SIX.
WE COUNTED THE KNOCKS FOR ELEVEN YEARS. THEY ADD UP TO A NAME.
~DO NOT LISTEN.~ LISTEN. IT IS THE ONLY WARNING YOU WILL GET.
IT DOES NOT HUNT THE WOUNDED. IT GATHERS THEM.
DO NOT BUILD THE SECOND STAIR AGAIN.
NINE WENT DOWN. NINE WERE COUNTED IN THE WALL. ONE OF THE NINE WAS NOT OURS.
WE TRIED TO NAME IT. IT HAS TOO MANY.
HE KNOCKED BACK. HE IS THE KEYSTONE NOW.
THERE WAS A THIRD WAY. IT WENT UP. WE FILLED IT.
THE STAIR HAS 1,440 STEPS. COUNT THEM. IF YOU COUNT 1,441, STOP.
IF YOU HEAR TICKING, YOU ARE WHOLE. BE LESS WHOLE.
MEASURED AGAIN: FOURTEEN HANDS AND A KNOCK. STILL TOO AFRAID.
REST UNDER THE LAMP. DO NOT REST LONGER THAN THE LAMP.
THE LATE ARE NOT PUNISHED. THEY ARE USED SOONER.
THE THROAT WAS CUT IN FORTY YEARS. IT FILLED IN THREE DAYS.
WHERE DO THE FALLEN GO? WHERE ELSE WOULD WE PUT THEM?
WHAT WE #DID TO THEM# HERE, WE DID WITH LOVE.
THE NAVE WAS NOT DESIGNED. IT IS WHAT WAS LEFT WHEN WE STOPPED ADDING.
EACH COLUMN IS A FAMILY. THE TALL ONE IS STILL GROWING.
THE SPIRE POINTS HOME.
ONE LIGHT UP. ONE STILL ONE DOWN. THE BOOKS MUST BALANCE.
~WE FED IT.~ NO. WE WERE FED.
SHE CARRIED IT UP IN THE NIGHT. SHE LEFT THE PLACE EMPTY. BY MORNING THE WALLS WERE WALKING.
THE GRATE IS NOT TO KEEP IT OUT.
TOO SHORT. TOO WIDE. TOO AFRAID. NEXT.
KEEP YOUR ARMS AS THEY ARE. IT IS CUT THAT WAY.
XLI
MEASURED FORTY TIMES. CUT ONCE. IT FITS NOW.
FOR THE ONE WHO COMES DOWN WHOLE.
THERE IS NO STAIR UP. THERE NEVER NEEDED TO BE.

I TO XL: NOT YET.
XLI:
